tables.name: chats
tables.label: Chats
tables.description: Top-level conversations, newest first in the chat list.

tables.name: subchats
tables.label: Threads
tables.description: Each chat's conversations: its main thread plus any child chats branched from it. Each carries its own model, system prompt and web switch.

tables.name: messages
tables.label: Messages
tables.description: What you and the assistant said, per thread. Attachments are stored inside the row.

tables.name: providers
tables.label: AI providers
tables.description: Your configured AI provider choices (ids and names only), mirrored by the app so a chat can pick one. Never holds keys.

tables.name: agent_changes
tables.label: Agent changes
tables.description: Files the folder agent edited in the open chat (path and kind only, never contents). Device-local: rebuilt by the Mac app, never synced.

tables.name: agent_status
tables.label: Agent status
tables.description: One-line status of the folder agent for the open chat (folder, what it may edit, what it is asking). Device-local: rebuilt by the Mac app, never synced.

tables.name: models
tables.label: AI models
tables.description: The models the open chat's AI provider offers (ids and names only), mirrored by the app so a chat can pick one. Never holds keys or addresses. Device-local: rebuilt from the provider's live list, never synced.

tables.name: ai_status
tables.label: AI status
tables.description: One plain line about the open chat's AI connection (shown above the composer). Device-local: rebuilt by the app, never synced; never holds a key or address.
